name: MathlibAnnex.Analysis.CStarAlgebra.IsCompactOperatorModel
title: A compact-operator model for a representation

content.display_title: A compact-operator model for a representation
content.one_sentence_role: Packages faithfulness together with the equality $e(A)=\mathcal K(H)$.
content.natural_language_statement: Let $A$ be a complex $C^*$-algebra, with no unit assumed, let $H$ be a complex Hilbert space, and let $e:A\to\mathcal B(H)$ be a $*$-representation. The predicate below asserts that $e$ identifies $A$ exactly with the compact operators on $H$.
content.definition_explanation: The three conditions are $$e\text{ is injective},\qquad e(A)\subseteq\mathcal K(H),\qquad\mathcal K(H)\subseteq e(A).$$ Equivalently, $e$ is faithful and $e(A)=\mathcal K(H)$; hence $A$ is $*$-isomorphic to $\mathcal K(H)$ through the specified representation.
content.assumptions: No separability, irreducibility or singleton-spectrum hypothesis is part of this definition. A unit is not assumed.
content.conclusion: The output is a property of the given representation $e$, not merely an assertion that some abstract $*$-isomorphism exists.
